messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: high 5xx error rate detected for inference-gateway (rule: inference.gateway.5xx_rate > 4% over 3m). PD link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/P7654321
jamie: ack — i'm oncall, taking lead. opening triage.
mike: grafana shows a sudden jump in 502/503 from ~T-9m, spike mainly from eu-central edge cluster.
sasha: service-traces show a canary (gateway:v2.15) rolled out ~T-12m, ~10% traffic routed to it in eu-central.
jamie: good catch. canary timing lines up. quick checks:
```
# health check
curl -i https://gateway-eu.example.com/health || true
# check k8s rollout revision
kubectl -n inference get deploy gateway -o yaml | yq '.status.conditions'
```
mike: logs include a bunch of upstream connection resets + kvcache timeouts around the same time:
```
2026-03-14T02:09:12Z gateway[pid=421] WARN upstream: connection reset by peer
2026-03-14T02:09:15Z gateway[pid=427] ERROR kvcache: request timeout=2500ms
```
lia: support looped in top affected customers for eu-central. no support tickets yet, one customer noted elevated latencies but no hard failure.
jamie: initial mitigation plan: 1) pause/rollback canary to stop new canary traffic 2) enable regional circuit-break on eu-central to shed 25% of traffic to us-east temporarily 3) scale dedicated inference pool by +1 GPU node. executing now.
jamie: @deploy-bot pause canary deployment for gateway:v2.15 in eu-central
deploy-bot: pause job accepted (job id: pause-3344). status: pausing canary -> in-progress.
mike: triggering pool scale (pool dp-07) +1 node
infra-bot: scale accepted. desired=12 -> new_target=13 -> in-progress.
sasha: adding short customer blurb to status page: "We are investigating elevated error rates in EU region; mitigation actions in progress."
jamie: adding temporary route rule:
```
# shift 25% eu-central -> us-east
redwood route update inference --region eu-central --shift us-east=25
```
sasha: route update applied. watching error-rate and kvcache.
mike: kvcache timeouts falling, upstream resets dropping. eu-central 5xx rate down from 6.8% -> 2.0% in last 4m.
jamie: good. keeping PD incident open until stable for 20m. adding notes to P7654321.
pagerduty: Incident P7654321 acknowledged by jamie.
jamie: follow-ups: 1) postmortem to investigate canary's keepalive handling and connection pooling 2) add canary preflight guard: abort canary if 5xx > 0.5% for >2m 3) consider progressive traffic ramp with health probes for kvcache-backed routes.
mike: preparing hotfix: increase proxy keepalive timeout to 90s for canary target and disable HTTP/2 connection coalescing for new canaries. Will push patch to staging then prod if green.
lia: customers notified; support will monitor for 2 hours and escalate if any repro.
sasha: taking post-incident owner. will collect logs, timeline, and deploy checklist. planning follow-up meeting in 24h.
jamie: handing off to sasha in 10m. will stay on-call for the handover window.
sasha: got it, taking ownership. closing temporary route after 30m stable.
jamie: thanks all — leaving PD notes and links to logs. 
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty incident P7654321 updated: status=triggered -> mitigated. Postmortem owner assigned: @sasha."
